subject: [RFC PATCH v3 14/14] mm/page_alloc: steer allocations away from exhausted memory tiers

2026-08-07.patch_summary: This patch modifies the Linux kernel's page allocator to steer allocations away from memory tiers that are exhausted, reducing unnecessary churn caused by reclaiming memory after allocation. It does this by making the page allocator aware of tier limits at allocation time and steering the first allocation attempt to nodes with available headroom in their tiered limit. This only affects movable allocations and is disabled unless tiered memcg limits are enabled.
